throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.init: addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8' --asm 'st.b $r4, $r20, 0; st.b $r5, $r20, 8; st.b $r6, $r20, 16; st.b $r7, $r20, 24; st.b $r8, $r20, 32; st.b $r9, $r20, 40; st.b $r10, $r20, 48; st.b $r11, $r20, 56'

notes: No destination data dependency; latency is not defined. Throughput only.
